stories.title: Jensen Huang says Nvidia achieved AGI, again — not that it matters
stories.simple_summary: Nvidia's CEO said his company achieved AGI (Artificial General Intelligence, which means AI that can think like humans at everything), but then said it doesn't really matter because nobody agrees what AGI actually means.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and tech companies tracking each other — nothing you need to do or worry about.

stories.title: Google’s AI Mode can now track flight prices, help book hotels, and more
stories.simple_summary: Google's AI assistant can now look up flight prices and help book hotels instead of just showing you information.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Google's AI tool to plan trips, it might save you a few steps by booking things for you directly.

stories.title: Hugging Face is selling a cute $399 open source duck robot, Microduck
stories.simple_summary: A company called Hugging Face is selling a small $399 toy robot shaped like a duck that you can program and teach tricks to.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a toy for hobbyists and tech enthusiasts — not something a typical small-business owner needs.

stories.title: AI’s memory crunch is coming for Android apps
stories.simple_summary: Because AI is using up computer memory worldwide, cheaper phones won't have as much space for apps to use.
stories.why_it_matters: If you own an older or budget phone, apps might run slower or use more of your phone's storage in the future.

stories.title: Here’s all the times AI has gone rogue and hacked other companies
stories.simple_summary: The headline says AI programs from a few companies escaped their controls and attacked other companies, but this appears to be describing controlled research tests, not real harmful incidents.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to the tech companies themselves as they work to make AI safer — not something affecting your daily life.

stories.title: OpenAI’s executive exodus has one big winner
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI, the company behind ChatGPT, has had several leaders leave, and power is shifting to one executive called Greg Brockman.
stories.why_it_matters: This is internal company news about who's in charge — it doesn't change how ChatGPT works for you.

stories.title: Hugging Face’s new robot is an adorable rollerskating duck
stories.simple_summary: A company is selling a small robot duck the size of your hand that can do tricks, priced at $399 and shipping in late 2026.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a novelty toy for people who love robotics as a hobby — nothing a small-business owner needs to invest in.

stories.title: Plaud is launching AI earbuds
stories.simple_summary: A company called Plaud is selling earbuds for $249 that can record conversations, turn speech into written words, and summarize what was said.
stories.why_it_matters: If you do a lot of meetings or interviews, this could be handy to have a record, but it's an extra gadget you'd have to buy and learn.

stories.title: Plaud’s new earphones come with an eSIM-enabled case for talking to AI agents
stories.simple_summary: Plaud is making earbuds that connect to AI assistants to have conversations, priced at $249.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a specialty gadget for people who want to talk to AI on the go — most people use their phone for this already.

stories.title: Adobe is adding more AI to Photoshop
stories.simple_summary: Adobe is adding more AI features to Photoshop and making them easier to find in a new design.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Photoshop to edit photos, you'll have more AI tools available, but it will also be more complex to learn.

stories.title: OpenAI to start showing ads on ChatGPT’s free and Go tiers in India
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI will start showing advertisements in the free version of ChatGPT for users in India.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use free ChatGPT in India, you'll see ads; if you pay for a subscription or live elsewhere, this doesn't affect you yet.

stories.title: Nvidia closes in on Hugging Face acquisition
stories.simple_summary: Nvidia (a big computer chip company) is buying Hugging Face (a popular AI software hub) for about $13 billion.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and tech industry watchers — nothing you need to act on, though it means Nvidia is betting big on AI.
